Hero.Concept: Hong Kong detective who plays by her own rules
Hero.Melodramatic Hook: Her old partner was killed in a warehouse raid that went wrong. The man who sold them out now runs a bank tower in Central, and she means to bring him down.

Gear and Notes.Gear: Badge, handcuffs, police radio, a battered sedan with a siren she isn't supposed to have.
Gear and Notes.Notes: Owes Uncle Kwok at the noodle shop a favour. Suspended twice this year.

Schticks.name: Two-Gun Fury
Schticks.description: Fire a pistol in each hand: one attack roll, the higher Damage of the two guns, plus 1.

Schticks.name: Badge Says Back Off
Schticks.description: Once a session, spend 1 Fortune to have the police on the scene take your side.

Schticks.name: Car Through the Window
Schticks.description: +2 to Driving checks when the chase goes through a building.
